description: This file defines a fake implementation of the DownloadEngine interface for testing or UI purposes. It manages in-memory download records, simulates download progress and completion, supports cancellation, and provides listing and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: FakeDownloadEngine
classes.description: A deterministic fake download engine for testing/ui purposes, implementing the DownloadEngine interface. Manages in-memory download records and timers to simulate download progress and completion.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new download record to the in-memory store with 'queued' status and sets a timer to simulate completion after 250ms.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing simulated download by removing its timer and updating the status to 'canceled'.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all download records sorted by creation time descending.

methods.name: getByContentId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific download record by its content ID.
